name: Vistella: The Stars of Your World
source:
"Amidst the darkness, a star has fallen into my world."

Vistella: The Stars of Your World is a linear fantasy slice-of-life romance featuring some horror elements. 

Follow the footsteps of Antonio Nhật, an ordinary 26-year-old photographer who unwittingly gets dragged into another world after a botched attempt at taking his own life. He must then explore his new surroundings, survive with the help of its denizens, and find a way to face his own past.

"Amongst the stars of your world, you are the brightest of all."

[From [url=https://greyes.itch.io/vistellatsyw]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“黑暗之中，一颗星星落入了我的世界。”

《维斯特拉：你的世界之星》是一部线性奇幻爱情片，带有一些恐怖元素。

跟随安东尼奥·纳特 (Antonio Nhật) 的脚步，他是一位26岁的普通摄影师，在一次失败的自杀尝试后，不知不觉地被拖入了另一个世界。然后，他必须探索新的环境，在居民的帮助下生存，并找到面对自己过去的方法。

“在你们世界的星星中，你们是最闪亮的。”

[来自[url=https://greyes.itch.io/vistellatsyw]Itch.io[/url]]
